learning_outcomes.text: Use of fundamental knowledge of Electrotechnics
Explanation of the constructive principles of the component elements (electrical appliances, electrical machines, static converters, etc.)
Description of the functioning principles of the converters
Explanation and interpretation of the functioning regimes of converters
Solving common problems in the field of converters using dedicated software packages and appropriate computer aided design (CAD) tools (ORCAD, MULTISIM)
Evaluate the results obtained from the use of software packages and computer aided design (CAD) tools in solving problems in the field of converters
Deepening the knowledge gained from this course and forming practical skills

syllabus_topics: Introductory notions. The place and role of converters in energy flow.
Power semiconductor elements
Choice, verification and protection of the power semiconductor elements
AC - DC converters
AC voltage inverters. Single-phase variators
AC voltage inverters. Three-phase variators
Cycloconverters
DC voltage variators. The step-down DC voltage variator
DC voltage variators. The step-up DC voltage variator
Voltage and frequency converters. The principle of operation and the scheme of principle
Single phase inverters with AM modulation
Three-phase voltage inverters with AM modulation
Three-phase current inverters with AM modulation
Voltage and frequency converters with PWM modulation
Presentation of the laboratory. Labor protection. General information on laboratory activity.
Command of thyristors and diodes with the help of dedicated circuits
AC - DC converters
Single-phase AC voltage variator
DC voltage variator
Single phase inverters with AM modulation
Recovery of laboratories. Final evaluation.
teaching_methods: explanations and discussions in the laboratory
individual work for the preparation of laboratory reports and measurements on experimental assemblies
Using Orcad and Multisim simulation programs

assessment_methods.method: VP/ testing theoretical and applicative knowledge (Oral or written assessment)
Testing during the semester + course reports
Tests for evaluating theoretical and applicative knowledge and monitoring results in laboratory

assessment_rules: Minimum performance standard: Knowledge of the operation of the main electronic power devices working in switching and of the control methods of the electronic power circuits. Criterion for grade 5: Knowledge of the operation of the main electronic power devices working in switching.
